name: Transient-event follow-up
question: Which reported transient events warrant classification follow-up now?

features.name: alert_freshness
features.rationale: Early-time classification carries the most information; value halves each day.

features.name: visibility
features.rationale: Follow-up must be feasible from the declared site in the window.

features.name: candidate_status
features.rationale: Unclassified candidates gain most from a classification spectrum.

features.name: relationship_support
features.rationale: A host association constrains the event class and distance.

features.name: observation_gap
features.rationale: Fast cadence is needed early in a transient's evolution.
